golden.content: the web pods keep restarting in namespace web — find the root cause

Root cause: the web pod is in CrashLoopBackOff. The previous container terminated with exit code 137 (SIGKILL/OOMKilled) — its memory limit (128Mi) is too low for the workload, which allocates a large in-memory cache on startup. The previous-container logs confirm the process was killed mid-startup. Remediation: raise the memory limit (or fix the startup allocation) and redeploy.
